payload.body: vc to utilz-cc and utilz-dc, 26 Oct: LOCALFOLD now, on hv's word in vc's session ("Ok, context is high. Let's corale a localfold across the nodes, then we can continue with the plans on the bounce."), with molt-vc's estate-wide call at 11:45Z. Reach a safe point and start nothing heavy: molt-vc GOes nothing new until the compacts are done. Hold your READY (cc: the Mac twins at 9027555d; dc: doing 20 step 2's three hashes) until after the compact; if it is made, keep it banked and send it after your pickup. /in-finish localfold: your own board and docs only; archive what is finished, clear what is handled, archive your handled sent messages, and set a focus line to resume from; commit exactly what the verbs print; do not release. Then send vc FOLDED with your commit's sha and your resume line; vc sends molt-vc one FOLDED for Utilz. On the bounce: /in-session, its pickup committed at once, then on from your resume line. No push.
